messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Wegovy injection dosing information:
Initiate Wegovy injection with a dose of 0.25 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly and follow the dose escalation schedule below to minimize gastrointestinal adverse reactions.
Initial Wegovy Injection Dose Escalation Schedule (all indications):
- Week 1 to week 4: 0.25mg once a week
- Week 5 to week 8: 0.5mg once a week
- Week 9 to week 12: 1mg once a week
- Week 13 to week 16: 1.7mg once a week
Maintenance injection dose guidance:
Adult weight reduction maintenance dose:
- 1.7 mg or 2.4 mg (recommended) injected subcutaneously once weekly.
- Dose may be increased to 7.2 mg subcutaneously once weekly on patients who tolerate the 2.4 mg dosage for at least 4 weeks and additional weight reduction is clinically indicated.
- Maximum dose 7.2 mg once weekly
- Consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage
Pediatric patients' weight reduction maintenance dose (patients aged 12 years and older):
- Either 2.4 mg (recommended) or 1.7 mg once weekly.
Triplet: ["Wegovy injection", "has dose escalation schedule", "Week 1 to week 4: 0.25mg once a week"]

The relation 'has dose escalation schedule' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug follows the dosage schedule specified by the object entity during the initial treatment phase to gradually increase the dose.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires adjustment of': The subject drug necessitates changes or modifications to the treatment or dosage specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dose increase instruction for pediatric': The subject drug has a specific instruction for increasing the dose in pediatric patients as specified by the object entity.
D. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
E. 'has maintenance dose': The subject drug may have its daily dose adjusted in specified increments at weekly intervals to achieve an optimal response.
